$comment: The core skills that are vendored verbatim from an upstream repository: what was taken, from where, at which commit, under which licence, the digest of every file taken, and why. The other skills in this directory are written in this repository and are not recorded here. A vendored file is never edited in place: a newer pin is a new commit here, the humanize regression run again over the same corpus (a failed regression means the old pin stays), and this file rewritten. apps/server/test/coreSkillSources.test.mjs holds the files to the digests below and the version in each SKILL.md to the tag.

regression.method: manuscript-humanize's verify_preserved.py over five documents, each humanized in place by a real DSH + DeepSeek session at the pin, handed the manuscript-humanize wrapper and the language's humanizer (the previous pin, then the new), two samples each, the verdict being the repository's script run on the final file against the corpus original, not the model's report of it.
corpus: the two texts of the 2026-10-10 humanizer acceptance (evals/acceptance/local-integration-20261010/skills-native/humanizers: an English and a Chinese paragraph with a source quotation, an interval, a citation and a claim marker)
the Chinese methods section of the manuscript-support result 2026-09-09-ms-001 (7 claim markers, 20 〔待补〕 placeholders)
the 摘要 and 引言 of the Chinese EMPA-KIDNEY report of the clinical-review-quality result 2026-09-28-review-001 (21 claim markers, 16 citations, intervals)
an English rendering of the same 摘要 written for this check, with one source quotation bound in the matrix (18 claim markers, 13 citations)
regression.result: 20 of 20 runs: verify_preserved.py exit 0 with no issue, the original untouched, every claim marker, citation index, number, source quotation and 〔待补〕 placeholder present. Both pins split long sentences now and then (the marker stays on the last part, with its number); a quoted phrase that was not a source quotation was reworded in both. The new pins edit half as much (median 10% of the characters against 20%) and leave the length alone (1.02 times the original against 1.15).

skills.name: humanizer
skills.why: The English half of the register pass that manuscript-humanize applies as the last step on a finished deliverable. v3.0.0 regrouped the patterns by what a writer is doing (staging, rhythm by rule, inflation, formatting by rule, leftovers, the wrong reader) and v3.1.0 added a 26th, a reply that re-explains what the reader already has. The upstream repository's own validate-package.py reads files that are not vendored (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, the plugin manifests); it is kept because the previous pin kept it, and it is not run here.

documents: d5 (the English rendering of the EMPA-KIDNEY 摘要)

skills.name: humanizer-zh
skills.why: The Chinese half of the same pass. The 2026-09-23 revision rewrites the skill around the failure that matters to an evidence deliverable: text that reads better and means something else. It tells the editor to keep facts, numbers, negations, conditions, attribution and the author's degree of certainty (a 可能 is never made 确定), to leave a paragraph alone when it has no fault, and to protect code, paths, links, headings and anchors in a file; its changelog says so. It no longer rewrites by counting words, dashes or triads.

documents: d4 (the EMPA-KIDNEY 摘要 and 引言)
